name: CraftersMC ✧ SkyBlock: End § Beyond!
description:
Explore an MMO SkyBlock server full of adventure. Start your journey now on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition!

⛰ CraftersMC SkyBlock 

Popular MMO SkyBlock experience is now here! New custom items, custom mobs, collections and brand new PvE mechanics, specially designed and optimized for players on Bedrock Edition. 

Dive into the game for more information. 

🗳 Vote Rewards 

Daily Vote Rewards:

• 1⭐️ Crystal Capsule 

• 150 CraftersMC Lobby XP

• Type white coloured in chat for 24 hours (renewable by voting every day)

You can get those daily rewards by typing /vote after voting.

Monthly Vote Rewards: 

• 10 randomly selected players from full voters win a monthly Gold rank!

• Everyone who vote all days in a month (or 1 less) win 375 SkyBlock Gems!
